evidence: We offer two beautifully designed venues for weddings, quinceañeras, corporate events, and milestone celebrations.
We are Old City Hall Restaurant, a local dining destination offering a curated menu and lively after-party events.
Our show features live entertainment, themed food, and immersive medieval atmosphere perfect for special occasions and group outings.
Private event rentals are available through a partner, Good Morning Maxwell.
We host micro-weddings, bridal and baby showers, birthday parties, and corporate gatherings in a space with soaring ceilings and a private patio.
We host live events, support youth and university programs, and provide state-of-the-art venues for gaming parties, tournaments, and corporate events.
Whether you're hosting a company party or a personal event, we provide space and services to make your occasion memorable.
We welcome reservations for groups of six or more, and we're happy to assist with special requests.
Whether you're starting your day with specialty coffee, unwinding with a house-made cocktail, or hosting an event on our outdoor patio, we've got something for everyone.
